summary: The study's design, preregistration, execution, analysis, and artifact archiving are complete and internally consistent; the reported results and archived traces support the manuscript's scientific claims. However, prior required revisions about manuscript presentation were not implemented: the main text still contains inline OpenAlex/archive URLs and extensive low‑level provenance (file paths, artifact hashes) and the Disclosure Statement repeats low‑level manifest entries. These presentation/provenance defects must be fixed before finalisation. No new scientific defects were introduced in this revision.
critical_issues: Main body still uses inline OpenAlex/archive URL tokens and archive‑style links in place of conventional IEEE numeric citations and a formatted reference list; this violates the prior required revision and standard scholarly prose expectations.

Main body and captions contain detailed file paths, artifact filenames, and full hash strings (execution/model_configuration.json, execution/raw_results.jsonl, SHA‑256 values, etc.) rather than a concise archival citation; this provenance inventory must be relocated out of the narrative and replaced by a single archival‑bundle reference.

Disclosure Statement, while present, enumerates low‑level manifest entries and full hashes inline instead of a compact prose disclosure that cites the archived run bundle and representative manifest SHA‑256 once; this must be rewritten to be concise and remain within pages 1–5.
required_revisions: Replace all inline OpenAlex URLs and archive‑style in‑text links with conventional numbered IEEE citations and include properly formatted BibTeX entries using the supplied terminal_bibliographic_records. Ensure every in‑text bibliographic claim cites one of those numbered references rather than an OpenAlex URL.

Remove or substantially condense inline file paths, raw artifact filenames, and full hash strings from the manuscript body, captions, and tables. Add a single concise sentence in Methods and in the Disclosure Statement directing readers to the archived run bundle and manifest (provide the manifest path and one representative manifest SHA‑256). Relocate the detailed provenance inventory to the archived artifact bundle only.

Rewrite the Disclosure Statement as compact scholarly prose that still covers required items (models used, adapter/framework, master prompt reference, preregistration id and SHA‑256, high‑level execution summary such as planned/completed episode counts and model_calls_used) without enumerating low‑level file paths or hashes inline. Keep the Disclosure Statement fully within pages 1–5.
optional_revisions: Consider adding a short methodological note in Methods justifying the paired bootstrap percentile CI choice given extreme low discordance and/or include an exact alternative bound for clarity (analysis artifacts for exact alternatives are archived).
Move the explicit statement that the optional preregistration pilot was not executed earlier in Methods to improve reader flow (this disclosure is required and already present).

Add a brief paragraph in Discussion contrasting the shared_initial estimand with estimands that permit resampling or iterative verifier‑guided regeneration and summarizing tradeoffs between repair budget and model‑call cost using archived repair_stage_count/model_calls_used values.
Edit figure/table captions to remove any remaining provenance wording and ensure concise interpretive captions suitable for IEEE two‑column formatting.
